backgrounds.name: Scholar
backgrounds.description: Raised among books. Learns Mending; starts steady.

backgrounds.name: Duelist
backgrounds.description: Trained to fight early. May duel formally, and can Brace in combat.

backgrounds.name: Socialite
backgrounds.description: You know everyone worth knowing. High spirits.

backgrounds.name: Prodigy
backgrounds.description: Raw talent that unsettles the faculty. Wields Fire Wall in combat.
